lines.en: label beachmas20:
scene littlebunny1
Somehow, I wind up in the backseat of a limousine heading to who-knows-where when, just moments ago, I was less than an inch from flipping the world on its head.
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我最后坐进了一辆豪华轿车的后座，驶向一个鬼才知道是哪儿的地方——而就在几分钟前，我距离把整个世界掀个底朝天还不到一寸。

lines.en: I’m not sure when I switched to auto-pilot, but it feels like every minute since leaving Noriko alone in her orange-tinted clearing has been the first minute of my life.
lines.zh: 我不记得自己是什么时候切到自动驾驶模式的，但自从把 Noriko 一个人留在那片染成橘色的空地之后，每一分钟都像是我生命的第一分钟。

lines.en: So I ask you-
lines.zh: 所以我想问你——

lines.en: When was the last time you felt alive?
lines.zh: 上一次觉得自己还活着，是什么时候？

lines.en: Because for me, it...
lines.zh: 因为对我来说，那……

lines.en: Fuck it.
lines.zh: 去他的。

lines.en: I don’t want to talk to you anymore.
lines.zh: 我不想再跟你说话了。

lines.en: : You know...you’re one of the last people I would have expected to end the night with.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……你是我最没想到会一起结束这一夜的人之一。

lines.en: : Oh? And why is that?
lines.zh: : 哦？为什么这么说？

lines.en: : Because I’ve been having a nonstop marathon of melancholy with girls that I know much better than you over the last forty-eight hours- in which I have barely seen you at all.
lines.zh: : 因为过去四十八小时里，我一直在跟比你熟得多的女生们没完没了地演忧郁马拉松——而这期间我几乎没怎么见过你。

lines.en: : That problem could be easily remedied by looking at me a little more, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这个问题很好解决，Sensei，你多看我几眼就行了。

lines.en: : My bad, Tobiko. I guess I just had other things on my mind.
lines.zh: : 我的错，Tobiko。大概是我脑子里装着别的事吧。

lines.en: : If you’re going to start playing the name replacement game again, please at least give me a human name. I like to believe I’m a tier or two above fish eggs.
lines.zh: : 如果你又要开始玩改名游戏，至少给我起个人类的名字吧。我总觉得自己要比鱼卵高上一两个档次。

lines.en: : As for your mind and what could have been on it, I apologize again for interrupting you and Maya. But I hope that what I am about to show you will make it at least somewhat worth it.
lines.zh: : 至于你脑子里装着什么，我再次为打断你和 Maya 道歉。不过我希望我接下来要给你看的东西，至少能让这一切值回票价。

lines.en: : Me too. Opportunities like that haven’t really been all that common for me.
lines.zh: : 我也希望如此。这种机会对我来说还真不常有。

lines.en: : Nonsense. You have plenty of opportunities to push the boundaries of what is and isn’t acceptable with your students every single day. I have heard the things they say about you, you know? I have ears.
lines.zh: : 胡说。你每天都有大把的机会去试探和学生之间什么能做、什么不能做的边界。她们说的那些话我可都听见了，你知道吧？我有耳朵。

lines.en: : Sure, but that’s not Maya.
lines.zh: : 是，可那不是 Maya。

lines.en: : Is there something special about Maya? Something she has that the rest of us do not?
lines.zh: : Maya 有什么特别的吗？有什么是我们其他人都没有的？

lines.en: : Well...
: There was.
lines.zh: : 曾经有。

lines.en: : And there’s not anymore?
lines.zh: : 现在没有了？

lines.en: : Things have changed a little, but...there probably still is. Explaining it would take a lot longer than a drive to...wherever it is you’re taking me right now, though.
lines.zh: : 情况有一点变化，不过……大概还是有。只是要解释清楚，花的时间可比开到……你正带我去的那个鬼地方要久得多。

lines.en: : Then I suppose I’ll be waiting with bated breath for whenever that time comes.
lines.zh: : 那么我就屏息以待，等那一天到来吧。

lines.en: : For now, I’m unfortunately going to have to blindfold you.
lines.zh: : 现在，很遗憾，我得把你的眼睛蒙上了。

lines.en: : What is it with your family and blindfolding people? Is Imani in the trunk? Who is going to try and sell me things this time?
lines.zh: : 你们家的人怎么都爱蒙人眼睛？Imani 在后备箱里吗？这回又轮到谁来向我推销东西了？

lines.en: : Shush. Surely, you don’t mind covering your eyes for a few minutes to repay me for all of the trouble I went through in order to ensure that we got away undetected.
lines.zh: : 嘘。为了不让人发现我们溜走，我可是费了老大的劲，你总不至于介意遮上几分钟眼睛来还这份人情吧。

lines.en: : I hope you realize how much trouble this is going to get me into. I already disappeared last night. There’s no way pulling that two nights in a row is going to end well.
lines.zh: : 我希望你明白这会给我惹多大的麻烦。我昨晚已经失踪过一次了。连续两晚来这一套，不可能有好下场。

lines.en: : I suppose I’m a bit of a troublemaker now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 这么说来，我现在算是个麻烦制造者了？

lines.en: : “Kidnapper” is probably more accurate.
lines.zh: : 说“绑架犯”大概更准确。

lines.en: : I wonder who it is that’s been such a bad influence on me?
lines.zh: : 我真好奇，是谁把我带坏成了这样？

lines.en: : I saw you talking to Molly earlier, so probably her.
lines.zh: : 我刚才看见你跟 Molly 聊过，大概是她吧。

lines.en: : Oh good. So you did look at me at least once.
lines.zh: : 太好了。这么说来，你至少还是看过我一眼的。

lines.en: : Was it on purpose? Or did you just happen to catch a glance while you were looking for Maya?
lines.zh: : 是有意的吗？还是你在找 Maya 的时候顺便瞥到的？

lines.en: : What happened to pretending you never saw anything?
lines.zh: : 你不是说好假装什么都没看见吗？

lines.en: : Rest assured, I won’t tell anyone else. But I seldom get opportunities to push your buttons and I think you look awfully cute when you’re on the defensive.
lines.zh: : 放心，我不会告诉别人的。只是我很少有机会能撩拨你，而且我觉得你处于守势的时候可爱极了。

lines.en: : I’m not defending anything.
lines.zh: : 我可没在防守什么。

lines.en: : Adorable. It’s like you’re a real, living thing all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 真可爱。就好像你突然变成了一个活生生的、真实存在的人似的。

lines.en: : Says the fish eggs.
lines.zh: : 鱼卵说这话还挺有分量。

lines.en: : Close your eyes, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 闭上眼睛，Sensei。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine. But the last time somebody told me to do that, I wound up with a tongue in my mouth.
lines.zh: : 好。不过上一次有人让我这么做，结果我嘴里多了一条舌头。

lines.en: : But there is always a tongue in- oh. Ew. Stop that.
lines.zh: : 可嘴里本来就一直有一条——哦。恶心。别想了。

lines.en: Touka leans over and wraps a blindfold around my head.
lines.zh: Touka 俯过身来，用一条眼罩缠住了我的头。

lines.en: scene littlebunny2
And then I take over again!
lines.zh: 然后我又接管了！

lines.en: Hi there! Everybody’s favorite narrator here to bash you over the head with as many life lessons as I’m able to fit in these scrawny little arms of mine.
lines.zh: 嗨！各位最爱的旁白在此，用我这双瘦巴巴的小胳膊能抱住的尽可能多的人生道理，狠狠砸你们的头。

lines.en: Or should I say...Lessons IN LOVE?! Ha! I kid, I kid. But only because I know breaking whatever wall that title lies behind will get your brain chugging.
lines.zh: 或者我该说……恋爱课堂？！哈！开玩笑，开玩笑。不过是因为我知道，把那个标题后面藏着的那堵墙砸开，能让你的脑子开始转动。

lines.en: So, it appears that our third beach vacation is coming to a close. And while a handful of doors have both opened AND closed over the last couple days, it’s important to remember that doors are just doors!
lines.zh: 那么，看来我们的第三次海滩假期要落下帷幕了。虽然这几天有几扇门既被打开又被关上，但重要的是要记住——门就只是门！

lines.en: What I mean by that is that there’s almost always something on the other side.
lines.zh: 我的意思是，门的另一边几乎总有东西。

lines.en: It doesn’t matter if it’s closed or open so long as there is latent awareness that objects exist on both sides! Right? Right!
lines.zh: 它是开着还是关着都不重要，只要你潜在地意识到两侧都有东西存在！对吧？对吧！

lines.en: Behind Door #1, we have two lovely, albeit relatively scary teenage girls about to connect in a way that both of them were beginning to feel they never would!
lines.zh: 一号门后面，有两位可爱——虽说也相当吓人——的少女，即将以一种她们俩都开始觉得自己永远不会有方式产生连接！

lines.en: The lesson? That following your heart is a double-edged sword! Especially when your heart keeps leading you toward a dead end with a face.
lines.zh: 教训是什么？追随你的心是一把双刃剑！尤其当你的心总把你引向一条死路，而死路还长着一张脸的时候。

lines.en: Take it away, Noriko!
lines.zh: 交给你了，Noriko！

lines.en: : Kirin!
lines.zh: : Kirin！

lines.en: : Uhh...hi? Aren’t you supposed to be hanging out with Sensei right now?
lines.zh: : 呃……嗨？你现在不是该跟 Sensei 在一起吗？

lines.en: : I did! And then we made out! And then we dry humped for like ten minutes! And then I came!
lines.zh: : 我是在一起啊！然后我们接吻了！然后又干蹭了大概十分钟！然后我就去了！

lines.en: scene littlebunny3
: Woah, really?! Then what?!
lines.zh: : 哇，真的？！然后呢？！

lines.en: : Then he left!
lines.zh: : 然后他就走了！

lines.en: scene littlebunny4
: What?! Why?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！为什么？！

lines.en: : Don’t tell me you were gonna force him to wear one of those stupid-
lines.zh: : 别告诉我你打算逼他戴上那种蠢——

lines.en: : No, no. I would have let him do whatever. He just had...other plans, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不不。他想怎么样都行。只是他……大概有别的事吧。

lines.en: scene littlebunny5
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I’m okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我没事。

lines.en: : Noriko-
lines.zh: : Noriko——

lines.en: : Seriously. I’m good. Progress is progress and I’m not about to rush him when he’s been so patient with me.
lines.zh: : 真的。我很好。有进展就是进展，他对我这么有耐心，我不会去催他的。

lines.en: : Are you just saying that because you think it’ll make it hurt less?
lines.zh: : 你这么说，只是因为你觉得这样会没那么疼吗？

lines.en: : It works for you, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这招对你不是挺管用的吗？

lines.en: : It’ll...hold you over for a little while.
lines.zh: : 它……能让你撑上一阵子。

lines.en: : Do you think it’ll last until we make it back home? Because I’d much rather cry on my bed than a random beach chair.
lines.zh: : 你觉得能撑到我们回家吗？因为我宁愿在自己的床上哭，也不想在一张随机的沙滩椅上哭。

lines.en: scene black
: Hah...what about a beach chair with your best friend on it?
lines.zh: : 哈……那如果沙滩椅上还坐着你最好的朋友呢？

lines.en: : That doesn’t really change how random the chair is.
lines.zh: : 那也改变不了这张椅子有多随机。

lines.en: : Get on.
lines.zh: : 上来。

lines.en: : Will you rub my head?
lines.zh: : 你会摸我的头吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but you’ll owe me a back massage before the year ends.
lines.zh: : 会，不过你得在年内欠我一次背部按摩。

lines.en: scene littlebunny6
Behind Door #2, a small group of friends with an appendage severed in the form of an absentee! But what is that disembodied limb up to right now? And why does its counterpart keep trying to find it?
lines.zh: 二号门后面，是一小群朋友，其中一个成员以“缺席”的形式被截断了！但那条离体的肢体此刻在干什么？为什么它的另一半一直在试图找到它？

lines.en: The short and easy answer would be that things are easier when you work as a team! And that two heads are always better than one!
lines.zh: 简短又好懂的答案是：团队合作的时候事情更简单！两个脑袋永远比一个好使！

lines.en: But the longer, more complicated answer involves a series of painful, psychological discussions in which we evaluate the concepts of codependency, adultery, honesty, and most importantly...hormones! Yay!
lines.zh: 但更长、更复杂的答案，牵涉到一连串痛苦的心理层面讨论——我们要在其中评估依赖共生、出轨、诚实，以及最重要的……荷尔蒙！耶！

lines.en: Take it away, gals!
lines.zh: 交给你们了，姑娘们！

lines.en: : Hah...come on, Otoha. At least give me a “Merry Christmas” or something. Anything.
lines.zh: : 哈……拜托，Otoha。至少跟我说句“圣诞快乐”什么的。什么都行。

lines.en: : Nodoka, what did you give Sana for Christmas? She’s been freaking out for almost an hour now.
lines.zh: : Nodoka，你送了 Sana 什么圣诞礼物？她都快疯了一个小时了。

lines.en: : The only thing that could possibly benefit her at such a confusing time in her life, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是唯一能让她在人生中如此迷茫的时刻受益的东西。

lines.en: : You didn’t.
lines.zh: : 你该不会。

lines.en: scene littlebunny7
: If that is what you wish to believe, my beloved Futaba. But know that any gift I give to anyone is done with only the most excessive amount of care.
lines.zh: : 如果你想这么相信，我亲爱的 Futaba。但请明白，我送给任何人的任何礼物，都倾注了最最过量的心意。

lines.en: : Ah! Guys! Guys! She finally texted back! And with...two hours and thirteen minutes to spare!
lines.zh: : 啊！各位！各位！她终于回消息了！而且……还剩两小时十三分钟！

lines.en: : But what does it say? What does-
lines.zh: : 可她说了什么？什么——

lines.en: scene littlebunny8
: Ooooooh...my god...
lines.zh: : 噢噢噢噢……我的天……

lines.en: : I’m so happy for you, Rin! Even though it probably wasn’t worth the time investment and-
lines.zh: : 我真为你高兴，Rin！尽管这大概不值得你投入那么多时间，而且——

lines.en: : Oh my. I’d recognize those breasts anywhere.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。那对胸部我到哪儿都认得出来。

lines.en: scene littlebunny9
: I should probably look a little closer just to be sure, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概该再凑近点确认一下。

lines.en: : What?! Why?! Who ignores someone for two days and then sends them naughty pictures?! That doesn’t make any sense at all!
lines.zh: : 什么？！为什么？！谁会先无视别人两天，然后突然发那种色情的照片过来？！这根本说不通啊！

lines.en: : Nodoka! Stop looking! And Futaba, this doesn’t make any sense to me either! But I am definitely not about to argue!
lines.zh: : Nodoka！别看！还有 Futaba，我也完全摸不着头脑！但我绝对不打算反驳！

lines.en: : Maybe this is her way of apologizing?! Or telling me she’s ready to start doing other stuff?!
lines.zh: : 也许这是她道歉的方式？！还是在告诉我，她准备好开始做别的事了？！

lines.en: : Either way! I suddenly have to go to the bathroom! Goodbye!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！我突然很想去趟洗手间！再见！

lines.en: scene black
: Oh, I’ll come. It’s safer to go in groups after all.
lines.zh: : 哦，我也去。毕竟结伴更安全。

lines.en: : No thanks, Nodoka! Please don’t come looking for me either!
lines.zh: : 不用了，Nodoka！也别来找我！

lines.en: What lesson did we learn this time, friends?
lines.zh: 这回我们学到了什么，朋友们？

lines.en: That’s right! That hiding the truth when it’s going to hurt someone isn’t always bad! In fact, sometimes it fixes everything! Hooray!
lines.zh: 没错！当真相会伤人的时候，把它藏起来并不总是坏事！事实上，有时候它能解决一切！万岁！

lines.en: : Okay...you can open your eyes now.
lines.zh: : 好了……你可以睁开眼睛了。

lines.en: scene littlebunny10
I open my eyes and...
lines.zh: 我睁开眼睛，然后……

lines.en: And I still have no idea where I am.
lines.zh: 而我依然不知道自己身在何处。

lines.en: scene littlebunny11
: Hmm...it’s smaller than it looked in the pictures. But I suppose this will do.
lines.zh: : 嗯……比照片上看起来要小一点。不过我想这也够用了。

lines.en: : Do what? Where are we?
lines.zh: : 够用来干什么？我们在哪儿？

lines.en: scene littlebunny12
: Your new apartment.
lines.zh: : 你的新公寓。

lines.en: : My what?
lines.zh: : 我的什么？

lines.en: : Apartment. It’s like a smaller, temporary housing unit in a-
lines.zh: : 公寓。就是那种更小、更临时性的居住单元，在——

lines.en: : I know what a fucking apartment is, Touka. What I’m asking is why you bought me one.
lines.zh: : 我知道他妈的公寓是什么，Touka。我问的是你为什么给我买了一套。

lines.en: scene littlebunny13
: Do you not like it?
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢吗？

lines.en: : That’s not the problem here. This is way too huge of a gift. And I already own a house.
lines.zh: : 问题不在这儿。这份礼物太夸张了。而且我已经有一栋房子了。

lines.en: : Yes, but this one is much closer to my house. And I have seen your home. It is rather outdated, Sensei. No offense.
lines.zh: : 是，但这套离我家近多了。而且我见过你家，Sensei。它相当过时了。无意冒犯。

lines.en: : I can’t accept this. There’s no way. Void the lease or something.
lines.zh: : 我不能收。绝对不行。把租约作废什么的。

lines.en: : There is no lease. I bought the entire building.
lines.zh: : 没有租约。我把整栋楼都买下来了。

lines.en: : Oh my god.
lines.zh: : 我的天哪。

lines.en: scene littlebunny14
: I thought it would be a good means of training myself to handle part of the family’s hospitality business once I enter college.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这会是个不错的手段，能训练我在上了大学之后接手家族酒店生意的一部分。

lines.en: : So...you’re my landlord?
lines.zh: : 所以……你是我的房东？

lines.en: : Landlady.
lines.zh: : 女房东。

lines.en: : Who else knows about this?
lines.zh: : 还有谁知道这件事？

lines.en: : Just Makoto. She told me it was a bad idea. But by the time I was informed of that, it was already too late.
lines.zh: : 只有 Makoto。她说这是个馊主意。可等我被通知到这一点的时候，已经太晚了。

lines.en: : You really need to start getting your presents approved ahead of time. This is insane.
lines.zh: : 你真的该开始提前把礼物拿去给人审批了。这太离谱了。

lines.en: scene littlebunny10
: I think it’s rather fun, actually!
lines.zh: : 可我觉得挺有意思的呀！

lines.en: : Come! We can test out the bed together!
lines.zh: : 来！我们可以一起试一试那张床！

lines.en: : Do you not hear yourself right now?
lines.zh: : 你听见自己刚才在说什么了吗？

lines.en: scene littlebunny15
Behind Door #3 we have more friends, joined this time by the stark realization that this world might be a little more complicated than we think!
lines.zh: 三号门后面是更多的朋友，这次还伴随着一个清醒的认识——这个世界也许比我们以为的要复杂一点！

lines.en: The lesson this time is that things ARE more complicated than we think. And also that I’m only a little bit jealous of Yumi’s chest. Wowza.
lines.zh: 这一次的教训是：事情确实比我们以为的更复杂。还有就是我对 Yumi 的胸口只有一丁点嫉妒。哇哦。

lines.en: : Hey. How’d it go? That took a lot longer than I thought it would.
lines.zh: : 嘿。聊得怎么样？比我预想的花了更久。

lines.en: : Sensei left a while ago...I was just over there thinkin’ about shit.
lines.zh: : Sensei 走了一会儿了……我刚才就在那边想些破事。

lines.en: : What kind of shit?
lines.zh: : 什么破事？

lines.en: : Chika, you ever, like...lose your memories? Or get really confused when trying to explain certain stuff?
lines.zh: : Chika，你有没有过……比如……失忆？或者在试图解释某些事的时候特别混乱？

lines.en: : Uhh...
: I mean, Sensei has memory problems, doesn’t he? I can’t really say I’ve ever experienced anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我是说，有记忆问题的是 Sensei 吧？我还真没经历过那种事。

lines.en: : Then...do you remember what me and him talked about after the Dorm Wars? Or...anything that’s happened over the last two months?
lines.zh: : 那……你还记得我和他在宿舍大战之后聊了什么吗？或者……这两个月里发生的任何事？

lines.en: : I remember the last two months, of course. But I have no clue what you and Sensei talked about back then. You never told me.
lines.zh: : 这两个月我当然记得。但我一点都不知道你和 Sensei 当时聊了什么。你从没告诉过我。

lines.en: scene littlebunny16
: Huh...
: This isn’t what you wanted to talk to Sensei about tonight, is it? Because I was assuming it was something a little more...I don’t know. Important?
lines.zh: : 这应该不是你今晚想跟 Sensei 谈的事吧？因为我一直以为会是更……怎么说呢……重要的那种？

lines.en: : Important how?
lines.zh: : 重要在哪方面？

lines.en: : Beats me. Maybe something about how much time you guys have been spending together lately?
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。也许是跟你们最近花了多少时间腻在一起有关？

lines.en: scene littlebunny17
: We’ve...what? Why? When?
lines.zh: : 我们……什么？为什么？什么时候？

lines.en: : Yumi, you can’t just never tell me anything and then ask me to recap your life for you. I just figured it had something to do with you getting let back into school.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你不能什么都不告诉我，然后又让我替你复述你的人生。我只是猜这跟你被允许回学校有关。

lines.en: : Do you remember that much at least?
lines.zh: : 至少这个你还记得吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, I-
scene littlebunny18
: I don’t remember shit...
lines.zh: : 我什么都不记得了……

lines.en: : Yumi...
lines.zh: : Yumi……

lines.en: : What the fuck is going on?
lines.zh: : 到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene littlebunny19
Here we are at Door #4!
lines.zh: 我们到了四号门！

lines.en: I had to mess with the handle a little bit to get this one open, but I wanted to make sure you saw it before the credits roll or however it goes when stuff like this normally ends for you.
lines.zh: 我得鼓捣了一下门把手才把这扇打开，不过我想让你在字幕升起之前、或者在这种东西对你来说平常结束之前，先看到它。

lines.en: Anyway, this one’s a little depressing, so I won’t bother with a full-on introduction this time.
lines.zh: 总之，这一扇有点压抑，所以我这次就不做长篇介绍了。

lines.en: But I will remind you that it’s okay to cry! Even when it feels like there’s nothing to cry about.
lines.zh: 但我还是要提醒你：哭出来是没关系的！哪怕你觉得根本没有什么值得哭的。

lines.en: Goodbye for now! I have to go bust down Door #5.
lines.zh: 暂时再见！我得去把五号门撞开了。

lines.en: : What am I doing here?...
lines.zh: : 我在这儿干什么？……

lines.en: : Maya?
lines.zh: : Maya？

lines.en: scene littlebunny20
: Uhh...hey! I didn’t realize you were...this far along the beach.
lines.zh: : 呃……嘿！我没注意到你们……走到海滩这么远的地方。

lines.en: : We were...looking for Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我们在……找 Sensei……

lines.en: : Is everything-
lines.zh: : 一切都还——

lines.en: scene littlebunny21
: Y-Yeah! Just...got some sand in my eyes. It’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 没、没事！只是……眼睛里进了点沙子。没什么。

lines.en: : Ami...maybe we should leave Maya alone for-
lines.zh: : Ami……也许我们该让 Maya 一个人待——

lines.en: scene littlebunny22
: Why are you lying?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要说谎？
: Ami？……

lines.en: : It’s okay to cry.
lines.zh: : 哭出来是没关系的。

lines.en: : Even when it feels like there’s nothing to cry about.
lines.zh: : 哪怕你觉得根本没有什么值得哭的。

lines.en: scene littlebunny23
: I’m not crying...
lines.zh: : 我没有在哭……

lines.en: : Maya!
lines.zh: : Maya！

lines.en: scene littlebunny24
: I’m not crying!
lines.zh: : 我没有在哭！

lines.en: scene littlebunny25
: I’m not...
lines.zh: : 我没有……

lines.en: scene happy9
: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

lines.en: scene littlebunny26
: I’ll get you a new mattress. This one isn’t as soft as I expected it to be.
lines.zh: : 我会给你换张新床垫。这张没有我想象中那么软。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you bought me a fucking apartment. What am I going to tell Ami?
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你给我买了一套他妈的公寓。我该怎么跟 Ami 说？

lines.en: : You don’t have to tell her anything if you don’t want to. It’s not as if I was expecting you to live here full-time.
lines.zh: : 你不想说就可以什么都不说。我本来也没指望你全职住在这儿。

lines.en: : I just figured it would be a convenient place for you to relax or take shelter from the many young girls fighting for your heart every day.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，这地方会很方便，让你能放松一下，或者躲开那些每天为你的心打得不可开交的小姑娘们。

lines.en: : Even I could tell it was getting to you during the Dorm Wars.
lines.zh: : 就连我都看得出来，宿舍大战期间那一切快把你压垮了。

lines.en: : Thank you, Touka. No one else ever believes me when I say that.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Touka。我说这话的时候，从来没人信过我。

lines.en: scene littlebunny27
: Ooh! I’ve always wanted to say this-
lines.zh: : 噢！这句话我一直想说——

lines.en: scene littlebunny28
: I’m not like the other girls...
lines.zh: : 我跟别的女生不一样……

lines.en: : Well, you’re certainly right about that. The only girl I can think of who’s had as grand of a gesture as this is Noriko and...
lines.zh: : 嗯，你说得确实没错。我能想到的、做过同样大手笔的女生只有 Noriko，而且……

lines.en: scene littlebunny29
: And I left her all by herself tonight...
lines.zh: : 而且今晚我还把她一个人丢下了……

lines.en: : You can’t please everyone all the time, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你不可能让所有人时时刻刻都满意，Sensei。

lines.en: : Pleasing one person one time might be a nice change of pace, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，只取悦一个人一次，或许会是个不错的改变。

lines.en: : I’m sure that day will come.
lines.zh: : 我相信那一天会来的。

lines.en: : But in the meantime, allow me to please you.
lines.zh: : 但在那之前，请允许我来取悦你。

lines.en: : Fine. But I need to close the window first so no one sees us.
lines.zh: : 好。不过我得先把窗户关上，免得被人看见。

lines.en: : And that’s my cue to leave.
lines.zh: : 那这就是我该退场的时候了。

lines.en: scene black
: You’re leaving already?
lines.zh: : 你这就走了？

lines.en: scene littlebunny30
: You didn’t expect me to live here with you, did you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会指望我跟你一起住在这儿吧？

lines.en: : No, but...it feels like you just got here.
lines.zh: : 没有，不过……感觉你才刚到。

lines.en: : I did. And so did you. But now, I have to be getting back to the beach house to continue celebrating with my friends.
lines.zh: : 我确实刚到。你也一样。不过现在我得回海滩别墅，继续跟朋友们庆祝了。

lines.en: : You’re welcome to come if you’d like, but the driver will be different and there won’t be a blindfold this time.
lines.zh: : 你想一起来也可以，不过司机会换一个，而且这次不会有眼罩了。

lines.en: : What’s wrong? I believe that was the moment where you were supposed to comment on not actually liking blindfolds or something along those lines.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？我以为这时候你该说一句你其实不喜欢眼罩之类的话。

lines.en: : I don’t think I want to go back to the inn.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不想回旅馆。

lines.en: : Worried the rest of the girls will see us come back together?
lines.zh: : 是怕其他女生看见我们一起回去？

lines.en: : Worried of who I’ll see.
lines.zh: : 是怕我会看见谁。

lines.en: : Hmm...My initial impression of you is proven more and more wrong every day.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我对你最初的那点印象，每天都在被证明是错的。

lines.en: : You really are interesting, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你真的很有意思，Sensei。

lines.en: : I don’t understand what you mean...
lines.zh: : 我不明白你是什么意思……

lines.en: : Nothing in particular. There are just certain things you do and say that make me want to baby you...similar to the way I do with Yasu.
lines.zh: : 没什么特别的。只是你某些言行让我很想把你当小孩宠……就像我对 Yasu 那样。

lines.en: : Please don’t.
lines.zh: : 别这样。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么不行？

lines.en: : Will it make you feel weak?
lines.zh: : 会让你觉得自己软弱吗？

lines.en: : You can act brave and strong all you want, but that facade won’t last forever.
lines.zh: : 你想装得多勇敢、多坚强都行，但那副伪装撑不了一辈子。

lines.en: : But at least now you have somewhere it can crumble in private.
lines.zh: : 不过至少现在，你有了一个可以让它私下崩塌的地方。

lines.en: : I think you should stay here with me.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你应该留下来陪我。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢？

lines.en: scene littlebunny31
: Boop.
: Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : I will not let you take shelter from your feelings in me. I’m far too smart for that.
lines.zh: : 我不会让你躲进我的身体里逃避你的感情。我可没那么好骗。

lines.en: : You’re afraid of new sensations...so you want to mask them with familiar ones instead. Is that right?
lines.zh: : 你害怕新的感觉……所以想用熟悉的感觉把它们盖过去。对吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think you understand-
lines.zh: : 我觉得你不明白——

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Sensei。

lines.en: : Oh, and kiss her next time. Idiot.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，下次记得吻她。笨蛋。

lines.en: scene black
: Wait-
lines.zh: : 等等——

lines.en: : The driver is waiting! Either you come back to the inn and talk to me along the way, or I will see you in school next Monday!
lines.zh: : 司机在等着呢！要么你跟我回旅馆、路上跟我说话，要么就下周一学校见！

lines.en: : That’s what I thought.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。

lines.en: scene littlebunny32
Fuck! Uhh...I got Door #5 open, but I kind of have to go now, so...bye!
lines.zh: 操！呃……五号门我打开了，不过我得走了，所以……再见！

lines.en: : Let the birds sing, dilly, dilly...And the lambs play~
lines.zh: : 让鸟儿歌唱，滴哩，滴哩……让羊羔嬉戏~

lines.en: : We shall be safe, dilly, dilly...Out of harm's-
lines.zh: : 我们安然无恙，滴哩，滴哩……远离伤害——

lines.en: scene littlebunny33
: Ah! Penemue! You can fly! Where did you learn how to do that?!
lines.zh: : 啊！Penemue！你会飞了！你是从哪儿学会的？！

lines.en: : Come down before you hurt yourself and I’ll reward you with a bucket of well water.
lines.zh: : 快下来，别伤着自己，我就奖励你一桶井水。

lines.en: : Well, aren’t you the cutest little thing?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，你真是最小巧可爱的东西，不是吗？

lines.en: scene littlebunny34
: Huh?
: Who-
scene minigod1
scene minigod2
scene minigod3
scene littlebunny35
Touka was right...I was trying to take shelter from my feelings by using her body as a shield.
lines.zh: Touka 说得对……我是在拿她的身体当盾牌，躲避自己的感情。

lines.en: It wasn’t my proudest moment, asking her to stay less than an hour after almost kissing Maya, but...I doubt Maya would even be surprised if she heard about it.
lines.zh: 在差点吻了 Maya 之后不到一小时就开口让她留下，这不是我最光彩的时刻，不过……我怀疑 Maya 就算听说了也不会惊讶。

lines.en: There’s no expectation placed on me to drop everyone else just because she and I are...what are we anyway?
lines.zh: 没有人要求我因为她和我……我们到底算什么来着？就放弃所有其他人。

lines.en: She never said anything and never did anything. So it’s kind of like nothing ever happened in the first place.
lines.zh: 她什么都没说过，也什么都没做过。所以就好像从一开始什么都没发生过一样。

lines.en: And if nothing ever happened in the first place, things right now aren’t any different from how they were last night when I forgot about her.
lines.zh: 而如果从一开始什么都没发生过，那么现在的一切，也就和我昨晚忘了她的时候没什么两样。

lines.en: I don’t even understand love in the first place, right?
lines.zh: 我本来就不懂什么爱，对吧？

lines.en: That was just a thing I said in the heat of the moment, right?
lines.zh: 那只是我在冲动之下随口说的一句话，对吧？

lines.en: And...her too.
lines.zh: 而且……她也是。

lines.en: She never would have acted that way if I never-
lines.zh: 如果我从来没有——她绝不会是那副样子。

lines.en: scene black
I wonder if there’s a pen around here?
lines.zh: 不知道这附近有没有笔？
